mapper.sql: P.PAY_NO, P.ORD_NO, P.PAY_MTHD, P.CARD_CO, P.INST_MM, P.FREE_INST_YN, P.PAY_AMT, P.CNCL_AMT, P.PAY_AMT - P.CNCL_AMT AS REMAIN_AMT, P.PAY_STAT, DECODE(P.PAY_STAT, 'W', '입금대기', 'A', '승인', 'P', '부분취소', 'C', '전체취소', 'E', '취소실패', P.PAY_STAT) AS PAY_STAT_NM, DECODE(P.PAY_MTHD, 'CARD', '신용카드', 'VBANK', '가상계좌', 'PNT', '포인트전액', P.PAY_MTHD) AS PAY_MTHD_NM, P.PG_TID, P.APRV_NO, TO_CHAR(P.APRV_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS APRV_DT, P.VBANK_CD, P.VBANK_NO, P.VBANK_DUE_DT, TO_CHAR(P.DPST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DPST_DT, TO_CHAR(P.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT , O.MBR_ID, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PAY_CNCL C WHERE C.PAY_NO = P.PAY_NO AND C.CNCL_STAT = 'F') AS FAIL_CNT FROM TB_PAY P JOIN TB_ORD O ON O.ORD_NO = P.ORD_NO
ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC, P.PAY_NO DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= #{PAGE_NO} * #{PAGE_SIZE} ) WHERE RNUM > (#{PAGE_NO} - 1) * #{PAGE_SIZE}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PAY P JOIN TB_ORD O ON O.ORD_NO = P.ORD_NO
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM TB_PAY P WHERE P.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} ORDER BY P.REG_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT PAY_NO, ORD_NO, PAY_MTHD, CARD_CO, INST_MM, FREE_INST_YN, PAY_AMT, CNCL_AMT, PAY_STAT, PG_TID FROM TB_PAY WHERE PAY_NO = #{payNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT PAY_NO, CNCL_SEQ, CNCL_TYPE, DECODE(CNCL_TYPE, 'A', '전체', 'P', '부분') AS CNCL_TYPE_NM, CNCL_AMT, REMAIN_AMT, CNCL_RSN, CLM_NO, PG_CNCL_TID, CNCL_STAT, DECODE(CNCL_STAT, 'S', '성공', 'F', '실패', 'R', '재처리완료') AS CNCL_STAT_NM, PG_RES_CD, PG_RES_MSG, RETRY_CNT, TO_CHAR(CNCL_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CNCL_DT FROM TB_PAY_CNCL WHERE PAY_NO = #{payNo} ORDER BY CNCL_SEQ

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PAY_NO, CNCL_SEQ, CNCL_TYPE, CNCL_AMT, REMAIN_AMT, CNCL_RSN, CLM_NO, RETRY_CNT FROM TB_PAY_CNCL WHERE PAY_NO = #{payNo} AND CNCL_STAT = 'F' ORDER BY CNCL_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT NVL(MAX(CNCL_SEQ), 0) + 1 FROM TB_PAY_CNCL WHERE PAY_NO = #{payNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PAY ( PAY_NO, ORD_NO, PAY_MTHD, CARD_CO, INST_MM, FREE_INST_YN, PAY_AMT, CNCL_AMT, PAY_STAT, PG_TID, APRV_NO, APRV_DT, VBANK_CD, VBANK_NO, VBANK_DUE_DT, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{PAY_NO}, #{ORD_NO}, #{PAY_MTHD}, #{CARD_CO}, NVL(#{INST_MM}, 0), NVL(#{FREE_INST_YN}, 'N'), #{PAY_AMT}, 0, #{PAY_STAT}, #{PG_TID}, #{APRV_NO}, DECODE(#{PAY_STAT}, 'A', SYSDATE, NULL), #{VBANK_CD}, #{VBANK_NO}, #{VBANK_DUE_DT}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO TB_PAY_CNCL ( PAY_NO, CNCL_SEQ, CNCL_TYPE, CNCL_AMT, REMAIN_AMT, CNCL_RSN, CLM_NO, PG_CNCL_TID, CNCL_STAT, PG_RES_CD, PG_RES_MSG, CNCL_DT ) VALUES ( #{PAY_NO}, #{CNCL_SEQ}, #{CNCL_TYPE}, #{CNCL_AMT}, #{REMAIN_AMT}, SUBSTRB(#{CNCL_RSN}, 1, 200), #{CLM_NO}, #{PG_CNCL_TID}, #{CNCL_STAT}, #{PG_RES_CD}, SUBSTRB(#{PG_RES_MSG}, 1, 500), SYSDATE )
